mapper.select:
select * from fnd_interface_lines t1
t1.line_number > nvl(#{readLine},1)
and t1.header_id = #{headerId}
and t1.sheet_name = #{sheetName}
and cast(t1.attributes_5 as char(2000)) = cast(#{attributes_5} as char(2000))
and cast(t1.attributes_1 as char(2000)) = cast(#{attributes_1} as char(2000))
order by line_number

select cast(t1.attributes_2 as char(2000)) as attributes_2, max((select v.code_value from
v where cast(v.code_value_name as char(2000)) = cast(t1.attributes_2 as char(2000)) and v.code = 'VAT.INVOICE_KIND'))invoice_kind, max((select m.bp_id from hls_bp_master m where cast(m.bp_name as char(2000)) = cast(t1.attributes_8 as char(2000)) ))bp_id, max(cast(t1.attributes_8 as char(2000))) as bp_name, max((select m.Enterprise_unified_credit_code from hls_bp_master m where cast(m.bp_name as char(2000)) = cast(t1.attributes_8 as char(2000)) ))bp_tax_registry_num, max((select m.invoice_bp_address_phone_num from hls_bp_master m where cast(m.bp_name as char(2000)) = cast(t1.attributes_8 as char(2000)) ))bp_address_phone_num, max((select m.invoice_bp_bank_account from hls_bp_master m where cast(m.bp_name as char(2000)) = cast(t1.attributes_8 as char(2000)) ))bp_bank_account, sum(nvl(cast(t1.attributes_13 as char(2000)),0)) as totalAmountStr, -- (sum(nvl(cast(t1.attributes_13 as char(2000)),0)) - sum(nvl(cast(t1.attributes_12 as char(2000)),0))) AS netAmountStr, max(nvl(cast(t1.attributes_13 as char(2000)), 0)) as netAmountBjs, max(nvl(cast(t1.attributes_12 as char(2000)),0)) as netAmountJs, sum(nvl(cast(t1.attributes_12 as char(2000)),0)) as taxAmountStr, max((select c.currency from con_contract c where c.contract_number = cast(t1.attributes_6 as char(2000)) and c.data_class='NORMAL')) currency, max(cast(t1.attributes_3 as char(2000))) as attributes_3, max(cast(t1.attributes_5 as char(2000))) as invoice_number from fnd_interface_lines t1
t1.line_number > 3
and t1.header_id = #{headerId}
group by cast(t1.attributes_2 as char(2000)) ,cast(t1.attributes_5 as char(2000))

select t1.ATTRIBUTES_1, t1.ATTRIBUTES_3, T1.ATTRIBUTES_4, T1.ATTRIBUTES_5, T1.ATTRIBUTES_11, t1.line_number from fnd_interface_lines t1
t1.line_number >= 1
and t1.header_id = #{headerId}
order by t1.line_number asc

SELECT ( SELECT c.contract_id FROM con_contract c WHERE cast(c.contract_number as char(2000)) = cast(l.attributes_6 as char(2000)) and c.data_class = 'NORMAL' ) AS contract_id, ( SELECT cc.cashflow_id FROM con_contract_cashflow cc WHERE cc.contract_id = ( SELECT c.contract_id FROM con_contract c WHERE cast(c.contract_number as char(2000)) = cast(l.attributes_6 as char(2000)) and c.data_class = 'NORMAL' ) AND cast(cc.times as char(2000)) = cast(l.attributes_10 as char(2000)) AND cc.cf_item = ( SELECT i.cf_item FROM hls_cashflow_item i WHERE cast(i.description as char(2000)) = cast(l.attributes_9 as char(2000)) ) ) AS cashflow_id, ( SELECT i.cf_item FROM hls_cashflow_item i WHERE cast(i.description as char(2000)) = cast(l.attributes_9 as char(2000)) ) AS cf_item, ( SELECT i.cf_type FROM hls_cashflow_item i WHERE cast(i.description as char(2000)) = cast(l.attributes_9 as char(2000)) ) AS cf_type, cast(l.attributes_10 as char(2000)) AS timesStr, cast(l.attributes_11 as char(2000)) AS taxTypeRateStr, nvl(cast(l.attributes_12 as char(2000)), 0) AS taxAmountStr, nvl(cast(l.attributes_13 as char(2000)), 0) as netAmountBjs, nvl(cast(l.attributes_12 as char(2000)),0) as netAmountJs,
cast(l.attributes_14 as char(2000)) AS description FROM fnd_interface_lines l
and l.header_id = #{headerId}
and cast(l.attributes_5 as char(2000)) = cast(#{attributes_5} as char(2000))

SELECT FIL.ATTRIBUTES_1, ( SELECT SCVB.VALUE FROM SYS_CODE_B SCB JOIN SYS_CODE_VALUE_B SCVB ON SCB.CODE_ID=SCVB.CODE_ID AND SCB.CODE='CSH.PAYMENT_METHOD' WHERE SCVB.MEANING=FIL.ATTRIBUTES_2) ATTRIBUTES_2, FIL.ATTRIBUTES_3, FIL.ATTRIBUTES_4, FIL.ATTRIBUTES_5, FIL.ATTRIBUTES_6, FIL.ATTRIBUTES_7, FIL.ATTRIBUTES_8, FIL.ATTRIBUTES_9, FIL.ATTRIBUTES_10, FIL.ATTRIBUTES_11, FIL.ATTRIBUTES_12, FIL.ATTRIBUTES_2 ATTRIBUTES_13 FROM FND_INTERFACE_LINES FIL WHERE FIL.LINE_NUMBER>1 AND FIL.HEADER_ID=#{headerId}

select line_id,header_id,line_number,status,error_message,sheet_name, attributes_1, attributes_2, (case when (cast(attributes_2 as char(500)) like '%\%%' escape '\' and cast(attributes_3 as char(500)) not like '%--%') then format(cast(attributes_3 as char(500)) * 100, 2) || '%' when (cast(attributes_2 as char(500)) like '%（倍）%' and cast(attributes_3 as char(500)) not like '%--%') then format(cast(attributes_3 as char(500)),2) else cast(attributes_3 as char(500)) end) as attributes_3,
(case when (cast(attributes_2 as char(500)) like '%\%%' escape '\' and cast(attributes_4 as char(500)) not like '%--%') then format(cast(attributes_4 as char(500)) * 100,2) || '%' when (cast(attributes_2 as char(500)) like '%（倍）%' and cast(attributes_4 as char(500)) not like '%--%') then format(cast(attributes_4 as char(500)),2) else cast(attributes_4 as char(500)) end) as attributes_4,
(case when (cast(attributes_2 as char(500)) like '%\%%' escape '\' and cast(attributes_5 as char(500)) not like '%--%') then format(cast(attributes_5 as char(500)) * 100, 2) || '%' when (cast(attributes_2 as char(500)) like '%（倍）%' and cast(attributes_5 as char(500)) not like '%--%') then format(cast(attributes_5 as char(500)),2) else cast(attributes_5 as char(500)) end) as attributes_5,
(case when (cast(attributes_2 as char(500)) like '%\%%' escape '\' and cast(attributes_6 as char(500)) not like '%--%') then format(cast(attributes_6 as char(500)) * 100, 2) || '%' when (cast(attributes_2 as char(500)) like '%（倍）%' and cast(attributes_6 as char(500)) not like '%--%') then format(cast(attributes_6 as char(500)),2) else cast(attributes_6 as char(500)) end) as attributes_6
from fnd_interface_lines
header_id = #{headerId}
and sheet_name = #{sheetName}
and cast(attributes_1 as char(500) )= cast (#{attributes_1} as char(500）)
order by line_number

select * from fnd_interface_lines t1
t1.line_number > 0
and t1.header_id = #{headerId}
order by line_number

select * from fnd_interface_lines t1
t1.line_number = nvl(#{readLine},2)
and t1.header_id = #{headerId}
order by line_number
